description_en: Invokes DescribeSagPortRouteProtocolList to obtain the list of ports on which routing protocols are enabled
description_zh: 调用DescribeSagPortRouteProtocolList获取路由协议开启的端口列表
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-sag-port-route-protocol-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-whfn0000 --smart-ag-sn sag32a300000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSagPortRouteProtocolList

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Smart Access Gateway
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the associated Smart Access Gateway device
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

RemoteAs.description_en: The autonomous system number of the peer BGP network

RemoteIp.description_en: The IP address of the peer

RouteProtocol.description_en:
The routable protocol of the port. Valid values:

STATIC: static routable protocol.
OSPF: OSPF dynamic routable protocol.
BGP: BGP dynamic routable protocol
RouteProtocol.description_zh:
端口路由协议：

STATIC：静态路由协议。
OSPF：OSPF动态路由协议。
BGP：BGP动态路由协议

Status.description_en:
The port status. Valid values:

UP: The port is enabled.
DOWN: The port is disabled
Status.description_zh:
端口状态：

UP：端口开启。
DOWN：端口关闭

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the query task was created

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. A value of 200 indicates that the query task succeeded
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码。200标识查询任务成功

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message. A value of Successful indicates that the query task succeeded
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 错误信息。Successful标识查询任务成功

State.description_en:
The status of the asynchronous task. Valid values:

Initialized: The query task is initialized.
Offline: The Smart Access Gateway device is offline and the query task has not been delivered. The task will be delivered after the device comes online.
Succeed: The query task is delivered.
Processing: The query task is being delivered.
VersionNotSupport: The current version of the Smart Access Gateway device does not support this operation.
BuildRequestError: The China Cloud Management Platform does not support this operation.
HardwareError: The query task failed to be delivered due to a device error.
TaskNotExist: The query task does not exist.
OfflineNotConfiged: The Smart Access Gateway device is offline and the query task has not been delivered. The task will not be delivered even after the device comes online
State.description_zh:
异步任务状态：

Initialized：查询任务初始化。
Offline：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后会继续下发。
Succeed：查询任务下发成功。
Processing：查询任务下发中。
VersionNotSupport：智能接入网关设备当前版本不支持。
BuildRequestError：管控不支持。
HardwareError：由于设备原因查询任务下发失败。
TaskNotExist：查询任务不存在。
OfflineNotConfiged：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后也不会下发
